name: Mana Well

summary: Workstation for certain reagents.
requirement: Alchemy 140; Leaded Vial, Kingsblood, Swiftthistle; blueprint drops from Rath'mael in Ruins of Lordaeron

name: Alchemy Laboratory
summary: Workstation for some Alchemy recipes, including flasks.

summary: Workstation for certain Enchanting formulas.

summary: Workstation for some patterns.
